record.paper_title: Some open problems related to small divisors
record.original_question: Does the nonlinear Schrödinger equation have an invariant measure on H^s, for sufficiently large s, whose support has non-empty interior in H^s?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.3.6 (S. Kuksin) Does (NS) have an invariant measure in HS such that its support (in HS) is a set with non-empty interior (here s is sufficiently large) ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the nonlinear Schrödinger equation
  i u_t + Δu = |u|^{2p} u,  (NLS)
posed on a compact spatial domain (e.g., the torus T^d or a bounded domain in R^d with appropriate boundary conditions), with p ≥ 1 a fixed integer. For a real number s sufficiently large that (NLS) is globally well-posed in the Sobolev space H^s, an invariant measure for (NLS) is a Borel probability measure μ on H^s such that, for every Borel set A ⊂ H^s and every time t ∈ R, μ(Φ_t^{-1}(A)) = μ(A), where Φ_t : H^s → H^s denotes the flow of (NLS) at time t. The support of μ is the smallest closed subset of H^s carrying full μ-measure.

Question: Does there exist an invariant probability measure μ for (NLS) on H^s (for s sufficiently large) whose support has non-empty interior in the topology of H^s?
artifact.status_search_result: Standard constructions of invariant measures for NLS (Gibbs measures by Bourgain, and fluctuation–dissipation limit measures by Kuksin–Shirikyan) typically yield measures supported on Sobolev spaces of low regularity, and there is no published result establishing or ruling out the existence of an invariant measure whose support has non-empty interior in H^s for large s. The available search evidence does not confirm a resolution, so the status appears unknown/open.

status_evidence.title: Periodic nonlinear Schrödinger equation and invariant measures (Bourgain)
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs Gibbs-type invariant measures for periodic NLS, supported on low-regularity Sobolev spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Known invariant measures are concentrated on rough function spaces, not on open sets of smooth H^s.

status_evidence.title: Kuksin, Comm. Math. Phys. 167 (1995)
status_evidence.snippet: Kuksin's approach treats Hamiltonian PDEs as infinite-dimensional dynamical systems and studies invariant measures.
status_evidence.claim: The question of supports with non-empty interior arises in Kuksin's program but is not resolved in the cited works.
